create_Unlock_env: create an Unlock environment instance with an optional seed for reproducibility
run_Unlock_step: run a step action in the Unlock environment and get observation, reward, done, and info
review_Unlock_gen_grid: review the Unlock class _gen_grid method that sets up a locked door and matching key

test_Unlock_toggle: test the Unlock environment step method to verify reward is given when the door is toggled open
